paite: TOUPA phat un. Aw TOUPA sikhate aw, phat unla, TOUPA min phat un.
heading: TOUPA Hoihna Phatna
english: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.

paite: TOUPA min phat in om hen, tu a kipan tangtawn in.
english: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

paite: Nisuahna a kipan atumna pha in, TOUPA min phat ding ahi.
english: From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.

paite: TOUPA nam chihte tung ah tungnungpek ahi a, athupina in vante akhup tham ahi.
english: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

paite: Tunglam a tutphah nei, TOUPA i Pathian bang kua ahia,
english: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,

paite: van a thil omte leh lei a thil omte en ding a kua kihihniam ahia?
english: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

paite: Ama'n genthei leivui a kipan akaithou a, tagah eklei a kipan adomkang hi.
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

paite: Miliante kiang a omsak theihna ding in, amite miliante kiang ngei ah.
english: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

paite: Ama'n numei chiing inn-le-lou akepsak a, tu leh ta neinu bang in nuamsatak in abawl hi. TOUPA phat un.
english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
